t: What Rehabilitation Outcomes Database Is All About
title: What Rehabilitation Outcomes Database Is All About
description: Rehabilitation restores function: stroke rehab rebuilds movement through neuroplasticity (constraint-induced therapy forces use of the weak limb), cardiac rehab cuts mortality ~25%, and pulmonary rehab eases COPD. Outcomes are functional — walking distance, independence scores (FIM), return to work — not just clinical numbers. Dose matters: intensity and repetition drive neuroplastic gains. This database is the complete rehabilitation outcome: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
